desc:
🏀 STEAL A BASKETBALL Player🏀

Steal eggs from powerful bosses, load up your cart, and race back to your court before they 
catch you! 🥚💨

🏃 Train on treadmills to increase your Speed
🛒 Upgrade your cart to carry more eggs
🌎 Unlock new zones with faster and tougher bosses
🥚 Hatch legendary basketball players and build your dream team
🏀 Compete in 3v3 matches and lead your squad to victory
💰 Earn cash from your players — even while offline
🏏 Knock eggs out of other players’ carts!

🎁 Join the group for a FREE GIFT!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for future updates!
